description: Everything ETFIQ publishes about one fund: issuer, category, each number with its source and as-of date, and a one sentence verdict against what its label promises. benchmark is the fund's own (name, how set, fund return, benchmark return and gap per window), not the model-portfolio benchmarks (list_benchmarks). A closed fund answers with closed; a former ticker answers as the fund it trades as now.

ticker.description: Fund ticker, such as SPY. A renamed ticker is followed.

name: etf_profile

data.description: The answer; null on a refusal.
